_doc: Data only. Why this file exists, the 56-spurious-¿ incident that shaped the Spanish rule, and what you need before adding a language: docs/language-rules.md

es.promptLine: Spanish punctuation is paired: a sentence that IS a question must open with ¿ and close with ?, and one that IS an exclamation must open with ¡ and close with !. Apply this ONLY when the English is itself a question or exclamation — most UI strings are labels, titles, buttons or statements, and those stay declarative. Never turn a statement into a question
